name: ainet_find_by_net_id
description: AINet::FindByNetId walks the loaded AINet list and returns the net whose netId matches the requested id.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call AINet source target; g_AINetListHead is a zero-initialized BSS global in Binary Ninja/original data and source.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403510 validates fastcall ECX=netId, traversal from g_AINetListHead, comparison against AINet::netId at offset 0, next pointer traversal at offset 0x54, matching-net return, and null return when the list is empty or no id matches.
The native smoke verifies matching middle-node lookup, missing-id null return, and empty-list null return.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x403510 --build-root build\vc5-verify-403510-probe passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 23, VC object symbol size 32, 9 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
